text:
sarah.ops: Heads up — soft-open for Aurora A500 edge pools in fremont-2 and oslo-1 starts 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC. This is a warm-pool rotational capacity window for experimental Dedicated workloads. Please do NOT migrate production traffic yet. Docs and reservation guidance below. :sparkles:

miguel-eng: Nice — what's the expected per-GPU memory and perf vs A100x?

sarah.ops: Rough specs: 80GB VRAM, NVLink-enabled, FP16 throughput ~1.6x A100x in early internal runs. Still beta numbers; we'll publish formal bench results tomorrow. Treat as experimental for now.

devon-rt: How does this interact with fairshare / reserved buckets and our burst policy?

ops-bot: Notice: pools/aurora-a500 are in class "edge-rotational". Warm-reserve window = 2h, burst preemptible quota = 30% of pool capacity. Reservations outside warm window go into cold-reserve queue.

sarah.ops: TL;DR guidance: use reserved capacity for predictable SLOs. For short perf runs, use warm reservations. Don't expect guaranteed placement for production until GA.

anita-sre: Billing / chargeback — what tag should we use for experiment tracking?

matt-product: We'll add a console filter tomorrow but for now use charge code: aurora-beta-2026 (please include in reservation metadata).

sarah.ops: Reservation CLI example (copy/paste):
```
# reserve 2 GPUs in aurora-a500 pool in fremont-2 for 4 hours starting 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC
rdrctl reserve --pool aurora-a500 --region fremont-2 --count 2 --start 2026-04-02T08:00Z --duration 4h --meta "charge=aurora-beta-2026"
```

miguel-eng: I'll grab 2 GPUs for perf smoke tests now.

miguel-eng: rdrctl reserve --pool aurora-a500 --region fremont-2 --count 2 --start 2026-04-02T08:00Z --duration 4h --meta "charge=aurora-beta-2026"

ops-bot: Reservation confirmed (id: 44321) for miguel-eng — pool: aurora-a500, region: fremont-2, start: 2026-04-02T08:00Z, duration: 4h.

anita-sre: Oncall / escalation — who to ping if we see weird power or thermals?

sarah.ops: Primary oncall: anita-sre, backup: devon-rt. Pager and runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/aurora-a500 (internal). Please escalate to #eng-oncall and tag @anita-sre.

jamie-ps: Quick legal note — do not place any sensitive customer data on these pools until compliance sign-off. We'll post a checklist later.

sarah.ops: Agreed. We're adding an enforced label "no-customer-data" on aurora-beta-2026 reservations until clearance.

matt-product: FYI power/perf dashboards will be available in Console > Dedicated > Pools > aurora-a500 by EOD tomorrow.

miguel-eng: observed small perf variance vs devbench, will paste raw numbers in #eng-runtime after tests.

sarah.ops: Thanks — if you hit anything unexpected, drop logs and GPU traces in the thread or open a ticket with "aurora-a500-beta" tag. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Deployment note: edge fleet canary completed (fremont-2) — no infra incidents detected during canary window.

sarah.ops: Thanks team — rolling this out carefully. Ping me here for questions. :wave:
